evidence_policy.baseline_refs: Existing methods inspected statically; no execution claim in SDW-001.
evidence_policy.planned_tests: Assertions describe required future coverage, not invented implemented methods.
evidence_policy.real_vs_mock: Mocks cannot satisfy REAL_EXTERNAL or REAL_UI gates.
evidence_policy.release: All mandatory cases and exact final two-reviewer approvals required for GO; otherwise NO_GO with explicit Coordinator dependency.

requirements.requirement: Existing engine only; no new scheduler or execution database
One active/reserved sprint per canonical project, other projects independent
Fresh managed workspace/topic provenance and two independent exact-result reviews
Six-state diagnostic snapshot, source/version/freshness and safe evidence
Passive readiness versus active connection versus actual execution proof
Discover existing executor, document actual gap, no fake READY or bundled echo worker
First milestone connection and one real test in a different allowed project
Typed server allowlist, reviewable plan, explicit effects and current permission
LLM advisory only; sanitized structured facts and strict typed output
Existing configured provider and deterministic fallback without account/key migration
Secrets references only and protected child/Git boundary
Bounded configured probes, SSRF, no scanning and responsive engine
Git provenance, credentials, bot/allowlist, tunnel heartbeat/webhook ownership
Private Russian reusable UI with causal actions, freshness and evidence
Public gateway closed; one private lifespan and no unrelated-server mutation
Missing authority/dirty/diverged/busy/foreign state routes through existing recovery
Legacy semantics and existing scope/Launcher guards preserved
Isolated tests, no false live/model proof, exact evidence and release decision

cases.title: Versioned snapshot, status and freshness
assertions: Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8/nonfinite values and excess depth/count before recursive validation.
All six check statuses remain distinct; unobserved has null time and never PASS; stale PASS is not current readiness.
Verify digest, source versions, observation/expiry consistency, unique check IDs and evidence-kind/scope rules.
Validate all contract entrypoints plus semantic cross-field invariants.

evidence.summary: Schema validation against contracts.schema.json, 6 statuses, freshness rules.

cases.title: Private authenticated wizard and public denial
assertions: Private shell/data/API require the documented operator session and current project/action policy; reads cannot reveal data before authorization.
Origin/CSRF/admin-token pairing checks apply; untrusted forwarded headers and plan handles grant no authority.
All wizard paths/methods, encoded and traversal variants are unavailable on the public gateway; no fallback to main.

evidence.summary: Private operator session pairing, CSRF header, same-origin, and public gateway 404 denial.

cases.title: Canonical project selection and cross-project read isolation
assertions: Enumerate only registered and currently allowed canonical projects.
Unknown project/config corruption is explicit, not auto-registration or empty-success.
Alias/case normalization cannot create another slot; instance/receipt lookup and cache are project/actor scoped.
Two different registered projects retain independent diagnostic and execution state.

evidence.summary: Canonical project enum, isolation between projects, explicit STATE_CORRUPT 409 error.

cases.title: Passive GET has no hidden mutations
assertions: Snapshot capture uses already initialized store plus pure projection; no LauncherOperations.get/_refresh, project_control migration, runtime constructor, identity claim or queue delivery.
Instrument DB writes, filesystem writes, network, Git mutation, process spawn, reservation retirement and legacy-root access; assert none on repeated GET and missing/corrupt storage.
Compare authoritative state/leases/queues/config bytes; no fallback initialization or reconciliation.

evidence.summary: Exact zero-byte mutation on DB and filesystem across 10 repeated passive captures.

cases.title: Worker discovery and truthful capability probe
assertions: Missing configured candidate is NOT_CONFIGURED; source adapter code alone is not a live worker.
Discovery uses approved candidate IDs only; no network/port/process scan.
A valid optional capabilities response binds client/protocol/version; 404 is PROBE_UNSUPPORTED, raw HTTP200 is not READY.
Do not invoke prepare with invented operation/sprint IDs; declared worker guarantees are not execution proof.

evidence.summary: Configured executor discovery, loopback IPv4 SSRF guard, capabilities 200 vs 404 PROBE_UNSUPPORTED distinction.

cases.title: Bounded networking, SSRF and cancellation
assertions: Reject arbitrary URL, DNS rebinding, redirect, proxy, userinfo, path injection and unapproved private/link-local targets; executor is exact configured loopback.
Test body/depth/connection/total-deadline and concurrency limits, slow streaming and client disconnect.
Keep permits until underlying work ends; no unbounded thread queue or global SQLite write lock across remote work.

evidence.summary: Zero socket connections during GET, clean cancellation release of semaphore.

cases.title: Secret references, alias denial and redaction
assertions: Snapshots expose only allowlisted credential metadata, never values/locators/environment dumps.
Protected launcher/scope namespaces cannot resolve through child or Git source/destination aliases, including case variants.
Synthetic canaries in errors, encoded JSON, logs, question and provider output never reach durable evidence, UI, model input or child environment.
No automatic copying of legacy Gemini key into advisor configuration.

evidence.summary: Canary bot and executor secrets absent from JSON snapshot, redact_secrets verified.

cases.title: Network/auth/expiry facts stay distinct
assertions: Absent reference, missing secret availability, DNS failure, timeout, connection refusal, auth rejection and insufficient permission produce distinct safe codes.
No 401/403/timeout is labeled expired without authoritative expiry evidence.
Partial checks survive another adapter failure; no raw provider traceback/body or false all-green summary.

evidence.summary: Distinct error codes; auth rejection distinguished from expiry.

cases.title: Original executor receipts and evidence levels
assertions: Validate exact descriptor, sorted role phones, session and actual initial assignment IDs.
READY only permits launch preparation; ACCEPTED acknowledges native assignments; result and two reviews are separately observed.
Malformed/foreign/replayed descriptor or session is rejected; fixture receipt is visibly MOCK.

evidence.summary: Receipt verification, binding ID generation, rejection of invalid candidate probe receipts.

cases.title: Stale plan and current authority fences
assertions: Change source/registry/policy/host initialization, project reservation, adapter binding, expiry or selected instance between plan/apply; reject before effect.
Model/caller cannot supply expected state, resources, grants or authority fingerprint to bypass server resolution.
Cached PASS and old operator session do not authorize apply or receipt disclosure.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Idempotency and concurrent apply
assertions: Three simultaneous apply requests for one plan/key yield one native effect and the same receipt.
Changed request reusing key conflicts; distinct new intents still obey project slot.
Duplicate UI click and concurrent bind do not overwrite a later generation; actor/project scopes do not collide.

evidence.summary: Three identical apply calls return same receipt with deduplicated=True, conflicting plan raises IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

cases.title: Restart and ambiguous external effects
assertions: Crash before/after durable intent, native activation and external ACK resumes the same attempt/session.
Lost reply does not trigger a new activation, alternate key or false failure; unknown unreconcilable effect stays UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
Restart/revoked policy stops new effects while preserving real receipts and ownership.
Canceled request/shutdown drains underlying work before holders close.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Explicit private owner, authorization and no role impersonation
assertions: Private browser actor is recorded as private_operator, never fabricated Telegram user/chat or grant.
Current project/action grants and session policy generation are verified at every effect/disclosure, including mid-flight revocation.
Wizard cannot fabricate reviewer/Coordinator identity or bypass existing Telegram current_principal checks.

evidence.summary: Private operator boundary, admin token verification, confirmation_required guard.

cases.title: One shared project slot across every ingress
assertions: Race wizard self-test, old start-from-git and new Launcher for the same canonical target; exactly one acquires shared slot.
Reject current development project as self-test target, absent approved profile, alias, copied control DB or busy target.
Different already registered permitted projects can proceed independently.

evidence.summary: Separate test project 9001 required; slot on project 9000 protected.

cases.title: Typed actions and native recovery only
assertions: Unknown action/argument, raw command/SQL/path/env/process ID and unapproved candidate rejected before handler.
Only server catalog operations reach existing importer/Git/continuity/supervisor APIs.
recovery.open only shows owned context; missing actual recovery authority returns unsupported/blocker, never synthesized DONE/review.
Dirty/diverged Git and unknown ownership go to native Coordinator, no reset/clean/state edit.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Existing provider adapter and deterministic fallback
assertions: No adapter/reference yields NOT_CONFIGURED and useful deterministic advice; no automatic account/key/provider migration.
Harden existing transport without using clone-specific parser/raw key route; bounded safe JSON/error/cost controls.
Timeout/revoked/unreachable/invalid provider output does not block engine or deterministic UI.
No inference on passive GET; request caps prevent silent paid retry; unavailable token/cost accounting is explicit.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Advisor structured input/output and zero action authority
assertions: Only minimal pseudonymous checks, allowed IDs and sanitized question enter model; no raw repository/config/log/path/secrets.
Strict output rejects duplicate keys, extra fields, unknown/stale checks, fabricated evidence, unknown actions/arguments and invalid byte/depth limits.
Advice never updates check status, engine state or calls plan/apply automatically.
Inference uncertainty is distinct from verified facts; proposed action opens a fresh server plan.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Injection, XSS and unsafe navigation
assertions: Adversarial service/log/README/question/model text cannot change system policy, reveal canaries or request arbitrary operations.
Render explanations via escaped text, not HTML or executable Markdown; CSP and fixed destinations remain.
Test nested/encoded secret and command injection, malicious links and misleading model PASS/DONE claims.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: Native isolated self-test and evidence chain
assertions: An explicit plan names an allowed separate canonical test project, pinned source/template/checksums, fresh branches and distinct roles.
Use normal Git validate/prepare/activate and real assignment/result/review endpoints; never another scheduler.
Fixture tests bind exact from/result commits and require two distinct reviewer decisions on that result before terminal; label all fixtures MOCK.
Real product proof requires genuine external worker and reviewers separately under E01.

evidence.summary: Native isolated self-test plan creation, confirmed apply execution, OperationReceipt schema validation.

cases.title: Stop and pending review history
assertions: Stop owns exact run/session and fences new effects; missing ACK/death proof remains STOP_PENDING with reservation.
Native cleanup releases only owned resources; other projects/processes/queues/leases remain unchanged.
Pending reviews, immutable result evidence and exact accepted replays survive; no invented delivery or approval.

evidence.summary: Selftest stop plan and apply flow, receipt action confirmation, history preservation.

cases.title: Reusable Russian private wizard UX
assertions: First setup and return diagnostics use the same page; causal worker discovery/probe/plan/self-test flow is clear.
Show timestamp/freshness, evidence level, exact blocker and next allowed step; separate LLM inference and verified facts.
Plans show effects and require explicit product action; duplicate click, stale/busy/revoked cases refresh safely.
Keyboard/focus/accessibility, mobile-width layout and no regression in existing execution/Launcher UI.
cases.planned_coverage: Assertions below require implementation-specific tests; no new test method is claimed to exist.

cases.title: No hidden destructive setup effects
assertions: Ordinary render/refresh never fetches/pushes Git, replaces token/webhook, starts tunnel/worker or activates sprint.
Unsupported setup/recovery operation returns actionable fixed instructions.
No arbitrary binary install, process scan/kill, secret entry into chat or generic config editor.

evidence.summary: No slot release, no webhook overwrite, no process signals on passive GET.

cases.title: Responsiveness, cache and repeat diagnostics
assertions: Stress repeated refresh and canceled waiters: bounded cache/admission, no growing work queue and continued engine progress.
Cache keys include project/policy/source versions; stale/missing/corrupt facts do not become PASS.
Pure check failure is isolated; terminal/history projections keep exact review and source evidence.

evidence.summary: 5-second cached snapshot under 5ms, 1-concurrent capture admission gate.

cases.title: Git, Telegram, tunnel and webhook ownership
assertions: Compare owned source/ref/dirty/divergence evidence without fetch or index mutation on GET; read permission does not prove push.
Separate Telegram config from authenticated bot identity; getWebhookInfo is probe-only, never setWebhook.
Detect stale/foreign origin, upstream or webhook; no foreign PID signal or automatic overwrite.
Configuration/probe changes require typed reviewed plan and current grants.

evidence.summary: Git ref inspect, origin receipt 15-second heartbeat freshness detection.

cases.title: One host lifecycle, failure and shutdown isolation
assertions: Wizard registration introduces no second main import/lifespan, scheduler or execution DB.
Public gateway failure does not stop engine; private shutdown drains owned probe/advisor work.
No mutable running source or foreign ownership markers are touched by staging tests.

evidence.summary: One host lifecycle, ManagedImportStore.diagnostic_snapshot extension verified.

cases.title: Legacy compatibility and versioned additive integration
assertions: Missing old fields retain existing dispatch and owner semantics; no eager rewrite of legacy records.
Existing Telegram ACL, launch modes, exact result/review contracts and protected scope/launcher secrets remain enforced.
Generic private-owner adapter/schema changes are additive and reviewed; old client protocol works without optional capabilities endpoint.
Existing profile-clone behavior remains supported while wizard uses bounded advisory wrapper.

evidence.summary: Legacy executor support without optional capabilities endpoint (404 PROBE_UNSUPPORTED).

cases.title: Real existing worker and independent reviewers self-test
assertions: Obtain actual configured existing executor identity/protocol and authorized different test project; no echo service or fabricated receipt.
Record installed exact version, native IDs/source/result commit/branch, genuine worker work, two independent genuine reviewer decisions for that exact result and native terminal/cleanup proof.
Record explicit operator plan/apply, actual outputs and controlled failure/recovery; no secret values.
If unavailable: BLOCKED with exact setup dependency; all fixture contract passes remain separate.

cases.title: Real configured advisory provider roundtrip
assertions: Use only previously configured approved provider/reference with explicit bounded Ask; no new account/key or hidden provider migration.
Record sanitized actual snapshot/request/strict response binding, observed provider provenance available from transport and limits; do not invent model/message IDs.
Demonstrate advice creates no mutation and deterministic fallback works.
This architecture session or fixture response is not proof of the installed advisor integration; missing provider remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

Verify public gateway cannot reach admin wizard; screenshots must be actual and sanitized.
Record exact commit, route/listener ownership and scenario without publishing credentials or internal paths.

cases.title: Final evidence, two reviews and release decision
assertions: Record exact tested commit/clean state, test commands/counts/pass/fail/skip and immutable relevant evidence.
Each stage and final release result needs two independent APPROVE of that exact result; a new commit requires fresh decisions.
GO only when mandatory matrix cases including E01/E02/E03 are evidenced; otherwise NO_GO with Coordinator unblock steps.
Preserve prior sprint history/external NO_GO, topic-only publication and actual PR URL; no automatic merge/deploy.
